name: Precision / Product
description: 冷白工作室、深色产品雕塑、精确标注与分层拆解；适合产品机制和功能介绍。

canvas.adaptation: Reference composition; reflow freely for 9:16 or 1:1. Not an automatic aspect converter.

audio.note: Silent concept preview. Narration, character, voice, language and speaking rate remain user-controlled.

dependencies.fonts: Operating-system Arial/Georgia/monospace; none bundled or fetched. Font metrics can vary across systems.

variants.name: 结构拆解
variants.recipe: Use exploded-rings.svg as the hero. Separate layers by changing their y offsets; draw leader lines after each layer settles.

variants.name: 深色工作室
variants.recipe: Switch canvas to #15241f, text to #e8eee4 and retain the acid-green status light. Keep labels high contrast.

usage.remix: Use a large isolated object and two purposeful annotations. Keep a quiet silhouette and emphasize one surface treatment; replace the concept object with authorized product imagery when available.
usage.avoid: Do not reuse concept geometry as evidence of a real device, specification or measured performance. Avoid putting every feature around the object.
usage.motion: 0–1.8s: body rises and straightens; 1.6–3.0s: labels arrive; 2.3–3.1s: layer study enters. Remaining time holds the message with restrained surface motion.
usage.portrait: Place title in the top 28%, product in the middle 49%, labels and layer study at the bottom. Remove one annotation rather than shrinking all type.
usage.captions: Reserve an uncluttered caption band. Recompose labels rather than obscuring subtitles. Preview footer labels are not subtitles.
